subject.title: fix(agents): truncate tool results before overflow compaction

question: Should tool-heavy generic overflows persistently truncate historical tool results before attempting model-driven compaction by default?
rationale: Both orderings can be technically correct: truncation-first avoids multi-minute hangs and quota use, while compaction-first may preserve a richer summary of historical tool output; repository policy cannot choose that user-visible session-state tradeoff automatically.

options.title: Accept guarded truncation-first
options.body: Use the existing pressure heuristic and one-shot fallback as proposed, then update the documented recovery order and require refreshed exact-head validation.

options.title: Preserve compaction-first
options.body: Keep current ordering and pursue a shorter compaction timeout, race, or another explicitly sponsored recovery policy instead.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded truncation-first
recommendation.body: Use the existing pressure heuristic and one-shot fallback as proposed, then update the documented recovery order and require refreshed exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member who already refreshed and validated this exact branch and are best positioned to confirm the intended recovery-order policy.
